fusions.name: Snatched Petition
fusions.desc: Lashes the rod out to 5 tiles, dealing 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. The target moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Sudden Dismissal
fusions.desc: Slams the rod down, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Spring Away
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 15% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Croaked Rebuttal
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
